# Contraption: 3x3 flush piston door. Contract: doc/redstone/circuits.md, "3x3 flush door".
# Generated by experiments/wip/door3x3/scripts/door.py (stage "module"); the stages are in that folder.
#
# Module (box 0 1 0 .. 16 8 9; the doorway is 7..9 4..6 2, seen from the south; floor top y 3):
#   @D00..@D22  the nine door cells: smooth stone while closed, air while open
#   @IN  8 2 9  input block: power it to open (the test lever @L on top, buttons @SB @OB beside)
# Sides and top: sticky pistons in the wall plane (x 5 facing east, x 11 facing west, 8 8 2 facing
# down) pull their blocks into the wall; wire staircases in the wall plane power them.
# Center column: C (center) and M (bottom middle) rest in the floor (8 3 2, 9 3 2) when open.
# Below C: sticky piston B (8 2 2) on sticky piston A (8 1 2); W (10 3 2) pushes M west.
#   close: B spits C up one, W pushes M under it, B pushes both up and holds them;
#   open: B pulls M down, W pulls it aside, A lifts B, B pulls C down one, A lowers B, B pulls
#   C into the floor.
# Controller (behind, z 3..9): the input torch feeds a wire trunk (z 7) with short repeater
# branches. The spit is an observer behind B watching a wire spur. B's hold is the floor block
# 7 3 2 (quasi-connectivity: B extends exactly when M lands under C). W's driver is locked by a
# delayed copy of the input, so W stays out until B has pulled M down. A's pulse is a
# subtracting comparator (8 1 2's west). An observer in front watches A: its pulses reach the
# floor block 7 3 2, which powers B raised (pull C down one) and, by quasi-connectivity, B at
# home when A sets it down (the final pull).
#   redsim-cli door_3x3.redsim.json < examples/circuits/door_3x3.cli.txt
new size 40 force
note "3x3 flush piston door: power the input block @IN to open (test lever @L on top); closed 13 ticks after the input goes off, clear 28 after it goes on"
place 8 1 2 sticky_piston facing=up
place 8 2 2 sticky_piston facing=up
set 8 3 2 smooth_stone
set 9 3 2 smooth_stone
place 10 3 2 sticky_piston facing=west
set 6 3 1 stone
set 6 3 3 stone
set 7 3 1 stone
set 7 3 3 stone
set 8 3 1 stone
set 8 3 3 stone
set 9 3 1 stone
set 9 3 3 stone
set 10 3 1 stone
set 10 3 3 stone
set 10 1 3 stone
set 10 2 2 stone
place 10 2 3 repeater out=north
set 5 2 2 stone

place 6 3 2 redstone_wire

label SPIT 8 2 3

label A 7 1 2
label OBS 8 1 1
label LOCK 11 2 3
set 8 2 9 stone
place 8 2 8 redstone_wall_torch facing=north
place 8 3 9 lever face=floor powered=true
label IN 8 2 9 "input block: power it to open (the lever @L is the test harness)"
label L 8 3 9 "test lever on the input block"
label D00 7 4 2 "door cell (x 0, row 0)"
label D01 7 5 2 "door cell (x 0, row 1)"
label D02 7 6 2 "door cell (x 0, row 2)"
label D10 8 4 2 "door cell (x 1, row 0)"
label D11 8 5 2 "door cell (x 1, row 1)"
label D12 8 6 2 "door cell (x 1, row 2)"
label D20 9 4 2 "door cell (x 2, row 0)"
label D21 9 5 2 "door cell (x 2, row 1)"
label D22 9 6 2 "door cell (x 2, row 2)"
# harness: a stone button and an oak button on the input block's sides (the lever is on top)
place 9 2 9 stone_button face=wall facing=east
place 7 2 9 oak_button face=wall facing=west
label SB 9 2 9 "test stone button (20 ticks): a failure case"
label OB 7 2 9 "test oak button (30 ticks)"
settle
at 2 use 8 3 9
seek 40
rebase
prefab save door_3x3 0 1 0 16 8 9
group door_3x3 0 1 0 16 8 9 in @IN IN out @D11 C

target new lever "open: side cells clear 4 ticks after the lever, all nine 28 after; close: solid 13 ticks after"
target lever do at 5 use @L
target lever do at 60 use @L
target lever expect @D00 block=smooth_stone during 0..8
target lever expect @D01 block=smooth_stone during 0..8
target lever expect @D02 block=smooth_stone during 0..8
target lever expect @D10 block=smooth_stone during 0..8
target lever expect @D11 block=smooth_stone during 0..8
target lever expect @D12 block=smooth_stone during 0..8
target lever expect @D20 block=smooth_stone during 0..8

target lever expect @D00 block=air during 33..63
target lever expect @D01 block=air during 33..63

target lever expect @D10 block=air during 33..63
target lever expect @D11 block=air during 33..63
target lever expect @D12 block=air during 33..63
target lever expect @D20 block=air during 33..63
target lever expect @D21 block=air during 33..63
target lever expect @D22 block=air during 33..63
target lever expect @D00 block=smooth_stone during 73..90
target lever expect @D01 block=smooth_stone during 73..90
target lever expect @D02 block=smooth_stone during 73..90
target lever expect @D10 block=smooth_stone during 73..90
target lever expect @D11 block=smooth_stone during 73..90
target lever expect @D12 block=smooth_stone during 73..90
target lever expect @D20 block=smooth_stone during 73..90
target lever expect @D21 block=smooth_stone during 73..90
target lever expect @D22 block=smooth_stone during 73..90
target lever expect 8 3 2 block=smooth_stone at 60
target lever expect 9 3 2 block=smooth_stone at 60

target new oak "an oak button (30 ticks): all nine cells clear only 33..38, solid again from 48"
target oak do at 5 use @OB
target oak expect @D00 block=air during 33..38
target oak expect @D01 block=air during 33..38
target oak expect @D02 block=air during 33..38
target oak expect @D10 block=air during 33..38
target oak expect @D11 block=air during 33..38
target oak expect @D12 block=air during 33..38
target oak expect @D20 block=air during 33..38

target oak expect @D00 block=smooth_stone during 48..60
target oak expect @D01 block=smooth_stone during 48..60
target oak expect @D02 block=smooth_stone during 48..60
target oak expect @D10 block=smooth_stone during 48..60
target oak expect @D11 block=smooth_stone during 48..60
target oak expect @D12 block=smooth_stone during 48..60
target oak expect @D20 block=smooth_stone during 48..60
target oak expect @D21 block=smooth_stone during 48..60
target oak expect @D22 block=smooth_stone during 48..60

target new stone "failure case: a stone button (20 ticks) re-closes during the open sequence; the door sticks with the center cell empty"
target stone do at 5 use @SB
target stone expect @D11 block=air during 60..200
target stone expect @D00 block=smooth_stone during 60..200
target stone expect @D10 block=smooth_stone during 60..200

check
